description_en: Queries the details of a prefetch task, including the prefetch progress of all resources under the task. This API operation requires whitelist approval. If your bandwidth exceeds 100 Gbit/s, you can apply for whitelist approval through your account manager
description_zh: 查询任务预热详情，包括任务下所有资源的预热进度。该接口需要申请白名单后才可以使用，带宽大于100Gbps的情况下，可以通过您的商务经理申请白名单
name: DescribePreloadDetailById

parameters.help_en: The ID of the prefetch task. You can specify only one task ID in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
按任务ID查询预热任务详情。
支持单次查询一个任务ID。TaskId 需先调用 PushObjectCache 创建预热任务，并使用其返回的 PushTaskId；未创建过预热任务时无法构造有效取值
parameters.name: task_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of queried tasks

UrlDetails.description_en: The task details, including the task ID, start and end time, domain name, success rate, status, returned error code, and completion details of all URL resources
UrlDetails.description_zh: 任务详情。包括任务ID、起止时间、域名、成功率、状态、返回错误码、以及所有url资源的完成详情

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the task object was created. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务对象创建时间，使用UTC时间表示

Domain.description_en: The domain name of the prefetched resource

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task object ended. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 任务对象结束时间，使用UTC时间表示

Process.description_en: The completion progress of the task in percentage. This value indicates the percentage of edge nodes on which the prefetch task is completed
Process.description_zh: 任务完成进度百分比，代表预热任务在多少边缘节点上已结束

RetCode.description_en: The returned error code. A value of `0` indicates success
RetCode.description_zh: 返回的错误码，`0`表示成功

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Complete: The task is completed.
Refreshing: The task is in progress.
Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Complete：完成。
Refreshing：进行中。
Failed：任务失败

TaskId.description_en:
The ID of the task to be queried.

You can call the PushObjectCache operation to obtain the ID of the prefetch task from the response, and then query the prefetch status of the origin server resources by using the task ID.

You can specify only one task ID in a single call
TaskId.description_zh:
待查询的任务ID。

您可以调用PushObjectCache接口，从其返回值中获取预热任务的ID，并通过任务ID查询源站资源的预热状态。

支持同时传入单个任务ID

Urls.description_en: The completion details of all URL resources under the task
Urls.description_zh: 该任务下所有url资源的完成详情

Description.description_en:
The resource prefetch details.
If all edge nodes succeed, "Successfully preloaded" is returned.
If there are failed edge nodes, the failed details are returned, separated by "|"
Description.description_zh:
资源预热详情。
若全部边缘节点成功，则返回"Successfully preloaded"
若存在边缘节点失败，则返回失败详情，用"|"分隔

Success.description_en: The success rate in percentage. This value indicates the percentage of edge nodes on which the resource is successfully prefetched
Success.description_zh: 成功百分比。表示该资源在多少边缘节点上预热成功

Url.description_en: The URL of the prefetched resource
